objective.name: call
objective.description: Make one call to a tool of a registered MCP server, at most once per call_id, with a durable record of the attempt before anything is sent.

#root.role: Admit the caller (an Agentic model-selected call with a valid authority envelope, or a registered deterministic plan), resolve the server and the remote tool from trusted state only, check the arguments and the disclosure rules, reserve the call_id in the gateway journal, record transmitting, send the tools/call request once, classify what is known of the outcome, bound the result and commit the terminal state.

transformation_contract.morphing: A requested tool call becomes one recorded attempt with a classified outcome and a bounded result.
invariants: Exactly two kinds of caller are admitted. origin agentic: the envelope must verify with the registry's Ed25519 public key under the domain BRIQUE-MCP-AUTHORITY-V1, be unexpired, and its claims must equal call_id, projection_id, tool and the sha256 of arguments_json. origin plan: the address the engine set as the origin of the call (context and capacity) must be listed in the registry's plans. Anything else is refused, whatever it claims.

Server and remote tool come from trusted state only: for agentic, the persisted projection resolves tool (a model-visible name); for plan, server and tool (a remote name) are checked against the registry. A model-provided server, endpoint or credential is never used.
The current registry is checked again at every call: a server or tool removed or disabled since the projection fails closed.
If the tool's current fingerprint differs from the one in the projection, the call is refused as projection_stale and nothing is sent.
Arguments are at most 64 KiB, must validate against the projected input schema, must not contain a field the registry denies for the tool, and must not contain a secret value held by the gateway.
The call_id is reserved durably (written and flushed) before anything is sent, and transmitting is recorded durably before the request is written. At most one tools/call is sent per call_id.
The same call_id with the same envelope (or the same plan request) returns the existing attempt and its outcome; the same call_id with a different envelope or request is refused.
A tools/call answered with isError true is remote_error, a definite tool result. A JSON-RPC error from the server is remote_error with reason protocol.

A transport failure is failed_before_transmission only when the transport proves that no request byte was written; otherwise it is outcome_unknown. A deadline after the request may have left is outcome_unknown with reason deadline.
No automatic retry of a call that may have been transmitted.
The result is bounded: at most 256 KiB inline; non-text content blocks are replaced by a description; beyond the limit the result is truncated with truncated true, never silently.
A panic in the handler commits the most conservative state it can prove (outcome_unknown once transmitting was recorded) before answering.
success: The payload carries call_id, attempt_id, state among completed, remote_error, outcome_unknown, refused, failed_before_transmission, the reason when state is not completed, transmission among none, possible, complete, the bounded result when one was received, and the registry version used.
failure: invalid: call_id missing or not [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,128}, origin missing or unknown, or the parameters of the origin missing.

A refusal decided by the gateway is not an error response: it is state refused with reason among policy_denied, disclosure_denied, invalid_arguments, projection_stale, overloaded, authentication_required.
notes: For origin agentic: envelope, projection_id, tool (model-visible name) and arguments_json (the exact JSON text of the arguments the envelope hashes) are required; server and arguments are ignored.
For origin plan: server, tool (remote name) and arguments are required; envelope and projection_id are ignored.
Saturation of a server or of the gateway is refused at once with reason overloaded, before reservation; it is not the generic busy reason, so the wrapper library does not retry it.

effects.private_store: Appends the attempt's states to the gateway journal (reservation, transmitting, terminal).
effects.remote_servers: Sends at most one tools/call request for the call_id; its effect on the remote system is the remote tool's.
